description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a Medical Exam Preparation chatbot that implements Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It manages UI layout, session state, external API calls to OpenAI, and integrates with a vector store for document retrieval to answer user questions based on textbook chapters.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing vector-based document storage and retrieval, used for fetching relevant textbook chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings from text queries to facilitate similarity search.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs embedding of the user question, searches the vector store for relevant chunks, constructs a prompt, and calls the OpenAI API to generate an answer based on retrieved context.
